name: User can log in with valid credentials
description: Verify that an authenticated user can access the dashboard after entering valid credentials on the login page.

preconditions.value: User account exists and is active

steps.description: Navigate to the application login page
steps.expected: Login page is displayed with username and password fields
Credentials are accepted in the respective fields
User is redirected to the dashboard

steps.description: Verify the dashboard header displays the logged-in username
steps.expected: Dashboard shows welcome message with the authenticated user's display name
